pairs.why: B's trunk is slimmer and the fronds splay out more, like the real palm; A's trunk is fatter and its fronds bunch up behind big coconuts.
B is a taller barrel with a gentle bulge and a plain top, which matches the real barrel's part count; A is squat and adds a knob lid and rivets.
B has a chunky saucer with a tall dome and a visible underside, which fits the real cards' rounded masses; A is a flat, thin disc with a low dome.
A's bottle is long and slender and the cap loop sticks out at an angle, as in the real bottle; B is squatter and its loop stands upright.
A is a front-on circle with a thick, rounded rim like the real clock; B is squashed into a tilted oval with a thinner rim.
A has a thicker top slab, a stout pedestal on a wide base and chunky stools like the real cards; B has a thin top, a tall slender pedestal and spindly stools.
A's yoke and clamp are thick and the barrel is stout, close to the real fixture; B's truss and yoke are thinner, though A adds an extra orange band.
B's slide trough has a thick, tube-like body and thick green support poles like the real one; both add platform railings the real card lacks, and A's thin finials make it a little worse.
